description: Seamless navigation between Vim splits and Tmux panes using the same hotkeys. Requires a matching tmux configuration.
author: christoomey
tagline: Navigate Vim splits and Tmux panes seamlessly with Ctrl+hjkl

options.label: Vimscript Global Config
options.description: Raw Lua assignments for vim-tmux-navigator's global variables. vim-tmux-navigator is a Vimscript plugin with no require().setup() call — all configuration uses vim.g.* globals. Note: Vimscript reads these as integers, so use 1/0 (not true/false) for boolean options. The defaults shown here match the plugin's upstream defaults (all options off).
options.default:
-- vim-tmux-navigator: Vimscript plugin — configure via vim.g globals (use 1/0 for booleans)
-- vim.g.tmux_navigator_no_mappings = 1           -- uncomment to disable default <C-hjkl> mappings
-- vim.g.tmux_navigator_save_on_switch = 1        -- 1 = save current buffer, 2 = save all buffers
-- vim.g.tmux_navigator_disable_when_zoomed = 1   -- block navigation when Tmux pane is zoomed
-- vim.g.tmux_navigator_preserve_zoom = 1         -- keep zoom when navigating to another pane
-- vim.g.tmux_navigator_no_wrap = 1               -- disable wraparound at screen edges
-- vim.g.tmux_navigator_disable_netrw_workaround = 1  -- keep netrw's default <C-l> behavior

options.label: Disable Default Key Mappings (UI reference)
options.description: When enabled, the plugin will not create any key mappings. You must define your own mappings using the TmuxNavigate* commands. Use this if the default Ctrl+hjkl bindings conflict with other plugins. NOTE: This field is informational. Edit the 'Vimscript Global Config' field above to actually change this behavior (use integer 1, not true).

options.label: Save Buffers on Switch (UI reference)
options.description: Automatically save buffers when navigating from Vim to a Tmux pane. 0 = off, 1 = save current buffer (:update), 2 = save all buffers (:wall). NOTE: This field is informational. Edit the 'Vimscript Global Config' field above to actually change this behavior.

options.label: Disable Navigation When Tmux Pane Is Zoomed (UI reference)
options.description: When the Tmux pane running Vim is zoomed, block all outward navigation. Prevents accidentally unzooming when pressing navigation keys near the edge of the Vim window. NOTE: This field is informational. Edit the 'Vimscript Global Config' field above to actually change this behavior.

options.label: Preserve Tmux Zoom When Leaving Vim (UI reference)
options.description: When navigating from a zoomed Vim pane to another Tmux pane, keep the window zoomed. Has no effect when 'Disable Navigation When Zoomed' is enabled. NOTE: This field is informational. Edit the 'Vimscript Global Config' field above to actually change this behavior.

options.label: Disable Edge Wrapping (UI reference)
options.description: Prevent navigation from wrapping around to the opposite side of the screen when at an edge. Requires additional tmux configuration — see the plugin README for the matching tmux bindings. NOTE: This field is informational. Edit the 'Vimscript Global Config' field above to actually change this behavior.

options.label: Disable netrw Workaround (UI reference)
options.description: By default, the plugin overrides netrw's built-in Ctrl+l mapping so navigation still works in the file explorer. Enable this if you prefer to keep netrw's default Ctrl+l behavior. NOTE: This field is informational. Edit the 'Vimscript Global Config' field above to actually change this behavior.

functions.name: navigate_left
functions.label: Navigate Left
functions.description: Move to the Vim split or Tmux pane on the left
functions.whatItDoes: Moves focus to the split/pane to the left of the current one, crossing the Vim/Tmux boundary seamlessly.

functions.name: navigate_down
functions.label: Navigate Down
functions.description: Move to the Vim split or Tmux pane below
functions.whatItDoes: Moves focus to the split/pane below the current one, crossing the Vim/Tmux boundary seamlessly.

functions.name: navigate_up
functions.label: Navigate Up
functions.description: Move to the Vim split or Tmux pane above
functions.whatItDoes: Moves focus to the split/pane above the current one, crossing the Vim/Tmux boundary seamlessly.

functions.name: navigate_right
functions.label: Navigate Right
functions.description: Move to the Vim split or Tmux pane on the right
functions.whatItDoes: Moves focus to the split/pane to the right of the current one, crossing the Vim/Tmux boundary seamlessly.

functions.name: navigate_previous
functions.label: Navigate to Previous Pane
functions.description: Jump back to the previously active split or pane
functions.whatItDoes: Returns focus to whichever Vim split or Tmux pane was active before the last navigation.

functions.name: process_list
functions.label: Show Process List (Debug)
functions.description: Display the list of processes in the current Tmux pane for debugging
functions.whatItDoes: Runs :TmuxNavigatorProcessList to show what processes are detected in the current pane. Useful when navigation is not working to verify that Vim is being detected correctly.

exCommands.name: TmuxNavigateLeft
exCommands.description: Navigate to the Vim split or Tmux pane on the left.

exCommands.name: TmuxNavigateDown
exCommands.description: Navigate to the Vim split or Tmux pane below.

exCommands.name: TmuxNavigateUp
exCommands.description: Navigate to the Vim split or Tmux pane above.

exCommands.name: TmuxNavigateRight
exCommands.description: Navigate to the Vim split or Tmux pane on the right.

exCommands.name: TmuxNavigatePrevious
exCommands.description: Jump back to the previously active Vim split or Tmux pane.

exCommands.name: TmuxNavigatorProcessList
exCommands.description: Display the list of processes running in the current Tmux pane. Use this to diagnose issues where Vim is not being detected correctly.
